label: Essential Skills
description: Skills you need for most jobs such as reading, writing, math, and learning.

label: Foundational Areas
description: Areas that support learning and applying skills across many types of work.

label: Reading Comprehension
description: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

label: Active Listening
description: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

label: Writing
description: Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

label: Speaking
description: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

label: Mathematics (Essential Skills)
description: Using mathematics to solve problems.

label: Science
description: Using scientific rules and methods to solve problems.

label: Ways of Working
description: Ways of doing work that support learning and building skills.

label: Critical Thinking
description: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

label: Active Learning
description: Understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.

label: Learning Strategies
description: Selecting and using training/instructional methods and procedures appropriate for the situation when learning or teaching new things.

label: Monitoring
description: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

label: Transferable Skills
description: Skills you can use across different jobs such as communication, problem solving, and team work.

label: Social Skills
description: Skills used to work with others to achieve goals at work.

label: Social Perceptiveness
description: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

label: Coordination
description: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

label: Persuasion
description: Persuading others to change their minds or behavior.

label: Negotiation
description: Bringing others together and trying to reconcile differences.

label: Instructing
description: Teaching others how to do something.

label: Service Orientation
description: Actively looking for ways to help people.

label: Complex Problem Solving Skills
description: Skills used to solve new and challenging problems at work.

label: Complex Problem Solving
description: Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.

label: Technical Skills
description: Skills used to design, set up, operate, and fix machines and systems at work.

label: Operations Analysis
description: Analyzing needs and product requirements to create a design.

label: Technology Design
description: Generating or adapting equipment and technology to serve user needs.

label: Equipment Selection
description: Determining the kind of tools and equipment needed to do a job.

label: Installation
description: Installing equipment, machines, wiring, or programs to meet specifications.

label: Programming
description: Writing computer programs for various purposes.

label: Operations Monitoring
description: Watching gauges, dials, or other indicators to make sure a machine is working properly.

label: Operation and Control
description: Controlling operations of equipment or systems.

label: Equipment Maintenance
description: Performing routine maintenance on equipment and determining when and what kind of maintenance is needed.

label: Troubleshooting
description: Determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about it.

label: Repairing
description: Repairing machines or systems using the needed tools.

label: Quality Control Analysis
description: Conducting tests and inspections of products, services, or processes to evaluate quality or performance.

label: Systems Skills
description: Skills used to understand and improve systems at work, such as processes, decision making, or workflows.

label: Judgment and Decision Making
description: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

label: Systems Analysis
description: Determining how a system should work and how changes in conditions, operations, and the environment will affect outcomes.

label: Systems Evaluation
description: Identifying measures or indicators of system performance and the actions needed to improve or correct performance, relative to the goals of the system.

label: Resource Management Skills
description: Skills used to manage time, money, materials, and people effectively at work.

label: Time Management
description: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

label: Management of Financial Resources
description: Determining how money will be spent to get the work done, and accounting for these expenditures.

label: Management of Material Resources
description: Obtaining and seeing to the appropriate use of equipment, facilities, and materials needed to do certain work.

label: Management of Personnel Resources
description: Motivating, developing, and directing people as they work, identifying the best people for the job.

label: Knowledge
description: Information and understanding used across different areas of work.

label: Business and Management
description: Knowledge of principles and facts related to business administration and accounting, human and material resource management in organizations, sales and marketing, economics, and office information and organizing systems

label: Administration and Management
description: Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, human resources modeling, leadership technique, production methods, and coordination of people and resources.

label: Administrative
description: Knowledge of administrative and office procedures and systems such as word processing, managing files and records, stenography and transcription, designing forms, and workplace terminology.

label: Economics and Accounting
description: Knowledge of economic and accounting principles and practices, the financial markets, banking, and the analysis and reporting of financial data.

label: Sales and Marketing
description: Knowledge of principles and methods for showing, promoting, and selling products or services. This includes marketing strategy and tactics, product demonstration, sales techniques, and sales control systems.

label: Customer and Personal Service
description: Knowledge of principles and processes for providing customer and personal services. This includes customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction.

label: Personnel and Human Resources
description: Knowledge of principles and procedures for personnel recruitment, selection, training, compensation and benefits, labor relations and negotiation, and personnel information systems.

label: Manufacturing and Production
description: Knowledge of principles and facts related to the production, processing, storage, and distribution of manufactured and agricultural goods

label: Production and Processing
description: Knowledge of raw materials, production processes, quality control, costs, and other techniques for maximizing the effective manufacture and distribution of goods.

label: Food Production
description: Knowledge of techniques and equipment for planting, growing, and harvesting food products (both plant and animal) for consumption, including storage/handling techniques.

label: Engineering and Technology
description: Knowledge of the design, development, and application of technology for specific purposes.

label: Computers and Electronics
description: Knowledge of circuit boards, processors, chips, electronic equipment, and computer hardware and software, including applications and programming.

label: Engineering and Technology
description: Knowledge of the practical application of engineering science and technology. This includes applying principles, techniques, procedures, and equipment to the design and production of various goods and services.

label: Design
description: Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models.

label: Building and Construction
description: Knowledge of materials, methods, and the tools involved in the construction or repair of houses, buildings, or other structures such as highways and roads.

label: Mechanical
description: Knowledge of machines and tools, including their designs, uses, repair, and maintenance.

label: Mathematics and Science
description: Knowledge of the history, theories, methods, and applications of the physical, biological, social, mathematical, and geography

label: Mathematics (Knowledge)
description: Knowledge of arithmetic, algebra, geometry, calculus, statistics, and their applications.

label: Physics
description: Knowledge and prediction of physical principles, laws, their interrelationships, and applications to understanding fluid, material, and atmospheric dynamics, and mechanical, electrical, atomic and sub-atomic structures and processes.

label: Chemistry
description: Knowledge of the chemical composition, structure, and properties of substances and of the chemical processes and transformations that they undergo. This includes uses of chemicals and their interactions, danger signs, production techniques, and disposal methods.

label: Biology
description: Knowledge of plant and animal organisms, their tissues, cells, functions, interdependencies, and interactions with each other and the environment.

label: Psychology
description: Knowledge of human behavior and performance; individual differences in ability, personality, and interests; learning and motivation; psychological research methods; and the assessment and treatment of behavioral and affective disorders.

label: Sociology and Anthropology
description: Knowledge of group behavior and dynamics, societal trends and influences, human migrations, ethnicity, cultures, and their history and origins.

label: Geography
description: Knowledge of principles and methods for describing the features of land, sea, and air masses, including their physical characteristics, locations, interrelationships, and distribution of plant, animal, and human life.

label: Health Services
description: Knowledge of principles and facts regarding diagnosing, curing, and preventing disease, and improving and preserving physical and mental health and well-being

label: Medicine and Dentistry
description: Knowledge of the information and techniques needed to diagnose and treat human injuries, diseases, and deformities. This includes symptoms, treatment alternatives, drug properties and interactions, and preventive health-care measures.

label: Therapy and Counseling
description: Knowledge of principles, methods, and procedures for diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation of physical and mental dysfunctions, and for career counseling and guidance.

label: Education and Training
description: Knowledge of principles and methods for curriculum and training design, teaching and instruction for individuals and groups, and the measurement of training effects.

label: Arts and Humanities
description: Knowledge of facts and principles related to the branches of learning concerned with human thought, language, and the arts.

label: English Language
description: Knowledge of the structure and content of the English language including the meaning and spelling of words, and rules of composition and grammar.

label: Foreign Language
description: Knowledge of the structure and content of a foreign (non-English) language including the meaning and spelling of words, rules of composition and grammar, and pronunciation.

label: Fine Arts
description: Knowledge of the theory and techniques required to compose, produce, and perform works of music, dance, visual arts, drama, and sculpture.

label: History and Archeology
description: Knowledge of historical events and their causes, indicators, and effects on civilizations and cultures.

label: Philosophy and Theology
description: Knowledge of different philosophical systems and religions. This includes their basic principles, values, ethics, ways of thinking, customs, practices, and their impact on human culture.

label: Law and Public Safety
description: Knowledge of regulations and methods for maintaining people and property free from danger, injury, or damage; the rules of public conduct established and enforced by legislation, and the political process establishing such rules.

label: Public Safety and Security
description: Knowledge of relevant equipment, policies, procedures, and strategies to promote effective local, state, or national security operations for the protection of people, data, property, and institutions.

label: Law and Government
description: Knowledge of laws, legal codes, court procedures, precedents, government regulations, executive orders, agency rules, and the democratic political process.

label: Communications
description: Knowledge of the science and art of delivering information

label: Telecommunications
description: Knowledge of transmission, broadcasting, switching, control, and operation of telecommunications systems.

label: Communications and Media
description: Knowledge of media production, communication, and dissemination techniques and methods. This includes alternative ways to inform and entertain via written, oral, and visual media.

label: Transportation
description: Knowledge of principles and methods for moving people or goods by air, rail, sea, or road, including the relative costs and benefits.

label: Inventory management software

label: Label making software

label: Mailing and shipping software

label: Audit software

label: Enterprise resource planning ERP software

label: Tax preparation software
description: Software to manage or prepare financial information for tax reporting purposes.

label: Financial analysis software
description: Software to gather information or conduct financial analysis.

label: Time accounting software
description: Software to submit or manage time accounting for human resources.

label: Billing and invoicing software
description: Software to organize or automate billing, invoicing, or payment collection processes.

label: Computer game or entertainment software
description: Software to play games or provide entertainment on a computer.

label: Music or sound editing software
description: Software to record or convert analog sounds to a digital format, or to apply effects such as fades, noise filtering, or volume adjustment.

label: Content authoring and editing software
description: Software to create or edit digital content.

label: Pattern design software
description: Software to design or print custom cross-stitch or needlework patterns. May import photos or hand-drawn images.

label: Graphics or photo imaging software
description: Software to draw or manipulate images. May adjust colors, add text, or apply special effects.

label: Video creation and editing software
description: Software to enable production of video content.

label: Word processing software
description: Software to create, edit, store, or print documents.

label: Charting software
description: Software to draw or create diagrams or charts. May include pre-built templates.

label: Presentation software
description: Software to create presentations, speeches, or slideshows.

label: Web page creation and editing software
description: Software to develop or edit web sites or individual pages.

label: Calendar and scheduling software
description: Software to plan or organize the activities of a person or group.

label: Spreadsheet software
description: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells.

label: Optical character reader OCR or scanning software
description: Software to convert an image of text, such as a scanned paper document or electronic fax file, into electronic text which can be edited or used in other applications.

label: Desktop publishing software
description: Software to create or edit text and graphics into documents such as books, magazines, brochures, or manuals.

label: Content management software
description: Software to organize, store, or manage documents or media.

label: Content workflow software
description: Software to create, manage, or optimize content creation processes. May include collaboration or scheduling features.

label: Document management software
description: Software to store, organize, or search documents or files from other software or from paper copies.

label: File versioning software
description: Software to archive and track edits to files for comparison and reference.

label: Data management and query software
description: Software to store, retrieve, or analyze data.

label: Categorization or classification software
description: Software to organize or label large amounts of information for easier searching or management.

label: Clustering software
description: Software to combine and share resources across different technology tiers or architectures.

label: Customer relationship management CRM software
description: Software to manage customer interactions.

label: Data base management system software
description: Software to store, organize, or provide access to a set of related information.

label: Data base reporting software
description: Software to produce summaries or visualizations of raw data stored in a database system.

label: Data base user interface and query software
description: Software to query, present, or edit information stored in a database sytem.

label: Data mining software
description: Software to access or automatically extract information from a data source.

label: Information retrieval or search software
description: Software to efficiently search or access data from sources such as large collections of documents.

label: Metadata management software
description: Software to manage or store "data about data" such as author, creation date, file size, or keywords.

label: Object oriented data base management software
description: Software to store, organize, or provide access to data represented as a set of objects, rather than tables.

label: Portal server software
description: Software to manage or create information portals.

label: Transaction server software
description: Software to isolate business logic in programs from platform-specific code, so each can be maintained independently. May provide transaction management, clustering, failover, or load balancing.

label: Business intelligence and data analysis software
description: Software to present, visualize, or analyze data to help businesses make informed decisions.

label: Development software
description: Software to design, build, test, or maintain applications.

label: Configuration management software
description: Software to control, create, manage, or record the physical or functional characteristics of hardware or software.

label: Development environment software
description: Software to create or maintain applications which run on a computer or mobile device.

label: Enterprise application integration software
description: Software to connect different business systems to improve scalability or streamline work flows.

label: Graphical user interface development software
description: Software to create or maintain applications which interact with users through a graphical interface.

label: Object or component oriented development software
description: Software to create or maintain applications using object-oriented programming concepts.

label: Program testing software
description: Software to test or evaluate applications to ensure they comply with specified requirements.

label: Requirements analysis and system architecture software
description: Software to create, manage, or monitor product development processes to comply with standards, specifications, or risk management policies.

label: Web platform development software
description: Software to create or maintain applications accessed through web sites or using web technologies such as HTML.

label: Compiler and decompiler software
description: Software to transform code from one language to another. May convert human-readable source code into machine language.

label: Educational or reference software
description: Software to support learning or to access reference information.

label: Foreign language software
description: Software to translate text from one language to another, or to aid in learning or translating languages.

label: Computer based training software
description: Software to create, manage, or provide instructional material or courses accessed from a computer.

label: Spell checkers
description: Software to check the spelling of words in a document against a dictionary of preferred spellings.

label: Route navigation software
description: Software to assist users in moving from one location to another along a selected path or route.

label: Multi-media educational software
description: Software to educate children or students using interactive or gaming elements.

label: Dictionary software
description: Software to provide the meaning and spelling of words. May include etymology or thesaurus features.

label: Voice synthesizer and recognition software
description: Software to generate or understand spoken words in order to provide alternative or easier-to-use application interfaces.

label: Geographic information system
description: Software to capture, manage, analyze, or display geographically-referenced information.

label: Industry specific software
description: Software to support specific industries or specialized fields.

label: Aviation ground support software
description: Software to enable aircraft ground support operations. May include aircraft maintenence or baggage handling features.

label: Facilities management software
description: Software to track, monitor, or analyze a facility's assets, space availability, or tenant information.

label: Computer aided design CAD software
description: Software to design 2D or 3D objects. May include engineering or architectural features.

label: Analytical or scientific software
description: Software to capture data, perform analysis, or generate reports or visualizations to support scientific research.

label: Compliance software
description: Software to monitor, check, or correct processes to achieve compliance with standards or federal, state, or local regulations.

label: Flight control software
description: Software to identify and respond to changes in aircraft stability or control characteristics in order to maintain flight performance.

label: Industrial control software
description: Software to control, configure, or monitor industrial processes. May communicate with intelligent electronic devices.

label: Library software
description: Software to acquire, catalog, search, or manage circulation of books or other library materials.

label: Medical software
description: Software to evaluate, plan, or redesign healthcare procedures. May include reporting or visualization features.

label: Point of sale POS software
description: Software to enable billing and purchase of goods or services at retail markets or shops. May provide sales reports.

label: Computer aided manufacturing CAM software
description: Software to control machine tools which fabricate or assemble objects.

label: Manufacturing execution system MES software
description: Software to measure, control, or monitor production activities. May include material tracking, quality control, or scheduling features.

label: Computer aided design CAD and computer aided manufacturing CAM system
description: Software to create and fabricate objects using computer-aided design (CAD) and computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) features.

label: Risk management data and analysis software

label: Application server software

label: Desktop communications software

label: Interactive voice response software

label: Internet directory services software
description: Software to create or manage the mapping of files, users, or other network resources to unique identifiers.

label: Internet browser software
description: Software to view the contents of web pages and to navigate from one page to another.

label: Network management software

description: Software to monitor, analyze, or detect network systems.

label: Network operating system enhancement software

label: Administration software

label: Wireless software
description: Software to enable communication over wireless network protocols.

label: Bridge software

label: Platform interconnectivity software

label: Software defined networking/ virtualization software
description: Software to control or direct network traffic using virtual networks which work in conjunction with a physical network.

label: Operating environment software
description: Software to run or manage computer systems or support applications.

label: Filesystem software
description: Software to manage or create a file system for a computing device.

label: Network operation system software
description: Software to connect computers or devices to a network by providing or enhancing the base operating system.

label: Operating system software
description: Software to provide the operational interface to a computer and provide higher-level services and APIs.

label: Computer imaging software
description: Software to create, manage, or apply images of a computer's operating system and files, to configure or restore computers to a known state.

label: Security and protection software
description: Software to protect systems or data from unauthorized access or threats.

label: Authentication server software
description: Software to provide services for authenticating users across a network.

label: Network security or virtual private network VPN management software
description: Software to manage network access capabilities or policies.

label: Network security and virtual private network VPN equipment software

label: Transaction security and virus protection software
description: Software to protect sensitive information, ensure the safe transfer of data, or detect or remove malware or computer viruses.

label: Cloud-based protection or security software
description: Software to protect information and resources in cloud environments, or to protect systems by using a cloud-based service for updates or configuration.

label: Utility and device driver software
description: Software to maintain system performance or to enable hardware devices to function properly.

label: Data conversion software
description: Software to transform information from one format to another.

label: Data compression software

label: Device drivers or system software
description: Software to enable communication between hardware devices and applications or operating systems.

label: Voice recognition software
description: Software to convert spoken words into electronic text.

label: Storage media loading software
description: Software to control devices which automatically load or store data on media such as tapes, discs, or drives.

label: Backup or archival software
description: Software to back up information from computer systems to additional destinations such as networked servers or tape drives.

label: Text to speech conversion software
description: Software to convert electronic text into spoken words.

label: Eye tracking software
description: Software to track eye movements via a camera or similar device. May emulate a computer mouse or other input device.

label: Information exchange software
description: Software to send, receive, or manage information between systems or users.

label: Electronic mail software
description: Software to compose, send, or receive email.

label: Video conferencing software
description: Software to enable audio or video conferences between participants using networked devices.

label: Network conferencing software
description: Software to share files, remotely control computers, or transmit real-time data between participants using networked devices.

label: Instant messaging software
description: Software to enable private communication between participants using networked devices. May include chat rooms or notification services.

label: Map creation software
description: Software to place data or metadata on a map. May include surveying or engineering features.

label: Mobile operator specific application software
description: Software to support operations of mobile network or telecommunications service providers. May include billing, network planning, or customer service features.

label: Mobile messaging service software
description: Software to send or receive text or voice messages on a mobile device. May include SMS or voice mail capabilities.

label: Mobile location based services software
description: Software to provide content or services based on a device's geographical location.

label: Cloud-based data access and sharing software
description: Software to share or co-author computer files through cloud computing, where documents are stored in a central "cloud" of networked servers.

label: Enterprise system management software
